theorems.name: Submission.dor_lmb_fcd_jwc_minor_measurable_bound
theorems.statement: ∀ (k r : ℕ) (L : NNReal) (g : Fin r → Euclid k → ℝ) (V : Fin r → Euclid k), (∀ c, LipschitzWith L (g c)) → Measurable (fun x => Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun c b => fderiv ℝ (g c) x (V b))) ∧ ∀ x, |Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun c b => fderiv ℝ (g c) x (V b))| ≤ (r.factorial : ℝ) * ((L : ℝ) * ∑ b, ‖V b‖) ^ r
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
